en.name: Pacific Logistics Bridge
en.description: A future corporate challenge for operators building trade-finance, customs, and freight-visibility infrastructure across Pacific port corridors.
en.detailSubtitle: Built for companies improving how capital, goods, and shipment data move between Latin America and China.
en.metaTitle: Pacific Logistics Bridge | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Explore Pacific Logistics Bridge, a corporate challenge for trade, logistics, and financial infrastructure operators.
en.overviewHtml:
Pacific Logistics Bridge focuses on the connective tissue of cross-border trade: ports, customs, finance layers, and operational visibility.

The challenge is intended for mature teams that can improve throughput, financing, or execution quality across logistics systems.
en.eligibilityHtml:
• Companies building logistics software, trade-finance tools, customs systems, or freight intelligence.
  • Teams with enterprise readiness and a clear operator-facing use case.
  • Applicants able to explain measurable efficiency or risk-reduction outcomes.
en.supportHtml:
• Introductions to logistics operators, partners, and corridor stakeholders.
  • Feedback on deployment readiness and market-entry sequencing.
  • Support packaging the final submission for the challenge cycle.
en.processHtml:
1. Register interest through the shared form.
  2. Share your operational thesis, customer context, and supporting materials.
  3. Continue into follow-up review when the cycle opens.

br.name: Pacific Logistics Bridge
br.description: Um futuro desafio corporativo para operadores que constroem infraestrutura de trade finance, aduana e visibilidade de frete nos corredores portuarios do Pacifico.
br.detailSubtitle: Feito para empresas que melhoram como capital, mercadorias e dados de embarque circulam entre America Latina e China.
br.metaTitle: Pacific Logistics Bridge | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Conheca o Pacific Logistics Bridge, desafio corporativo para operadores de trade, logistica e infraestrutura financeira.
br.overviewHtml:
O Pacific Logistics Bridge foca no tecido conectivo do comercio cross-border: portos, aduana, camadas financeiras e visibilidade operacional.

O desafio e voltado a equipes maduras que conseguem melhorar throughput, financiamento ou qualidade de execucao em sistemas logisticos.
br.eligibilityHtml:
• Empresas com software logistico, ferramentas de trade finance, sistemas aduaneiros ou inteligencia de frete.
  • Times com prontidao enterprise e caso de uso claro para operadores.
  • Aplicantes capazes de explicar ganhos de eficiencia ou reducao de risco.
br.supportHtml:
• Introducoes a operadores logisticos, parceiros e stakeholders do corredor.
  • Feedback sobre prontidao de implantacao e sequenciamento de entrada em mercado.
  • Apoio para empacotar a submissao final do ciclo.
br.processHtml:
1. Registre interesse pelo formulario compartilhado.
  2. Compartilhe tese operacional, contexto de clientes e materiais de apoio.
  3. Siga para review quando o ciclo abrir.

cn.name: Pacific Logistics Bridge
cn.description: 一项即将开放的企业挑战赛，面向构建贸易融资、海关与货运可视化基础设施的成熟团队。
cn.detailSubtitle: 适合提升资本、货物和运输数据在拉美与中国之间流动效率的企业团队。
cn.metaTitle: Pacific Logistics Bridge | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 了解 Pacific Logistics Bridge，这是一项面向贸易、物流和金融基础设施运营者的企业挑战赛。
cn.overviewHtml:
Pacific Logistics Bridge 聚焦跨境贸易的关键连接层，包括港口、海关、融资和运营可视化。

该挑战面向能够提升物流系统吞吐、融资效率或执行质量的成熟团队。
cn.eligibilityHtml:
• 构建物流软件、贸易融资工具、海关系统或货运智能平台的公司。
  • 具备企业级准备度和明确运营方应用场景的团队。
  • 能够说明可量化效率提升或风险下降结果的申请者。
cn.supportHtml:
• 对接物流运营方、伙伴和通道相关利益方。
  • 关于部署准备度与市场进入节奏的反馈。
  • 帮助整理该挑战周期的最终提交材料。
cn.processHtml:
1. 通过统一表单登记意向。
  2. 说明运营逻辑、客户背景和支持材料。
  3. 在项目开放后进入后续审核。
